description: Locate files and folders by name instantly (beta version).
pre_install: Get-ChildItem "$persist_dir\*" -Include 'Bookmarks*.csv', 'Everything.lng', 'Everything*.db', 'Everything*.ini', 'Filters*.csv', 'Plugins*.ini', 'Run History*.csv', 'Search History*.csv', 'Session*.json', 'Omit Results.csv' | Copy-Item -Destination "$dir" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
pre_uninstall: if (!(is_admin)) { error 'Admin rights are required to stop Everything service'; break }
if (!(is_admin)) { error 'Admin rights are required to remove Everything service'; break }

Get-ChildItem "$dir\*" -Include 'Bookmarks*.csv', 'Everything.lng', 'Everything*.db', 'Everything*.ini', 'Filters*.csv', 'Plugins*.ini', 'Run History*.csv', 'Search History*.csv', 'Session*.json', 'Omit Results.csv' | Copy-Item -Destination "$persist_dir" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue -Force
